---
name: Bug report
about: Report an unexpected CLI or documentation result with a synthetic example.
title: ''
---

## What happened?
Describe the expected and observed behavior.

## Minimal reproduction
Use invented filenames and synthetic JSON only. Include the CLI command, exit
code, Node version, operating system, and whether this was preview or apply.
Do not attach real project code, secrets, credentials, or customer/attendee data.

## Evidence and limits
Paste only sanitized output. State what you checked and what remains unknown.
For suspected vulnerabilities, follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) and withhold
exploit details until a private reporting route is confirmed.
